summary: Threads run parts of a program at the same time. When two threads change the same variable, a threading.Lock makes them take turns so no update is lost.
notes: self.sold += 1 is not one step. It reads, adds, and writes, and another thread can run in between. That is a race condition.
with self.lock: acquires the lock and releases it at the end of the block, even if an error happens.
t.join() waits for the thread to finish. Print shared totals only after every join().
pitfall: A race condition may not show up on every run, so code that passed once can still be wrong. Lock every read-modify-write of shared data.
